messages:
Anya R: quick FYI — during yesterday's usability run the filter visibility toggle in Model Catalog got flagged. animation is nice but it hides keyboard focus and trips the accessibility check. screenshot: https://img.redwood/test/filters-anim.png Matt J: saw that. which toggle — the collapsed filter rail 'show filters' one? Anya R: yep that one in the left rail. when it expands the focus ring vanishes for a frame and VO (VoiceOver) reads nothing. also motion is pretty heavy. Jamie (prod UX): ugh. I remember we added that fade+slide to make it feel lighter. but accessibility > micro-anim. could we honor prefers-reduced-motion? Kevin - Eng: absolutely. we can switch to CSS that respects media query. example: ```css @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .filter-rail { transition: none; } } ``` Lisa - PM: also heard a user say the label 'Show filters' is ambiguous when a version pin modal is open — maybe \"Open filters\" vs \"Show\"? small copy tweak could help. Anya R: good call. also for the compare table we should ensure badges don't move during reflow when filters toggle. the performance badges jump a bit and that looks glitchy. Matt J: we can make badges reserve width with a min-width to avoid jump. feels like a style change not expensive. Jamie (prod UX): and for version pinning: when a user pins a model version the UI currently changes the pin icon only. we should add a textual state change for screen readers: aria-live region or role=\"status\" message like 'Version pinned' Kevin - Eng: agreed. simple aria-live will do. example snippet: `
` and we update innerText. designbot: accessibility-lint: color-contrast-fail on .filter-rail-bg (ratio 3.8:1), recommend #1f2b3a -> #16222d or increase text weight. Anya R: noted — change palette and add focus outline color. Lisa - PM: timeline? we should prioritize reduced-motion and aria-live this sprint. copy + badge spacing next sprint unless quick. Kevin - Eng: can do reduced-motion + aria-live in a single PR. will add CSS and small JS fallback for older browsers. Matt J: for copy I'll propose two options: 'Open filters' and 'Show filters (⌘/F)'. leaning to 'Open filters' for clarity. Jamie (prod UX): +1 'Open filters'. also add tooltip on hover with shortcut. Anya R: thanks team. can someone drop a short design note in the review doc with before/after gifs? I'll attach the VO repro steps. Kevin - Eng: I'll attach CSS diff and include test steps. Matt J: i'll update the copy change in Crowdin and ping translations. Lisa - PM: great — set the PR to "opt-in a11y" label and assign to Jamie for UX review. :thumbsup: Anya R: leaving this here for the record: main action items: 1) honor prefers-reduced-motion on filter toggle, 2) persist focus ring during expand, 3) add aria-live for version pinning, 4) reserve badge width to prevent reflow, 5) tweak copy to 'Open filters'. Jamie (prod UX): perfect. I'll follow up with mock and accessibility checklist. designbot: note: closing accessibility-lint issues will increase coverage metric by 0.6% Kevin - Eng: ping me if you need test accounts for VO repro — I have one set up. Anya R: thanks all — moving to #design-review board. :sparkles:
